delete.description: Deletes the saved Steam Access Token from your account. Use this endpoint if you want to disable trading automation. Once the token is removed, all trading automation features will be turned off for your account (since the system no longer has access to check your trades on Steam).

post.description: Manually triggers the trading automation system to check any of your pending trades (both deposits and withdrawals) and attempt to auto-resolve them. We already check this periodically. Your account must have an active token for this to work.

debug_message.example: Trade automation is not enabled on your account

get.description: Use this endpoint to check whether your account has the automation feature active.
Used to get a list of all currently blocked users.

delete.description: Used to unblock a user, allowing them to trade with you, and you with them.

items.description: Required array with array elements [id: itemId, coin_value: int] or [asset_id: int, coin_value: int]

post.description: Cancels multiple processing deposits. Once a bid has been placed items are no longer eligible to be cancelled.

message.example: You don't have a cancellable deposit.
You don't have a cancellable deposit.

10001.message: You don't have a cancellable deposit.

10005.message: You don't have a cancellable deposit.

coin_value.description: This is in coincents, so 1 coin = 100 coincents

post.description: Cancels processing deposit without any bids. Once a bid has been placed items are no longer eligible to be cancelled.

parameters.name: deposit_id
parameters.description: Deposit ID of the trade in question.

post.description: Sell an item immediately once it has at least 1 bid. Only works for auction sales.

parameters.name: deposit_id
parameters.description: Deposit ID of the trade in question.

post.description: Mark an item as sent after having sent it on Steam.

parameters.name: deposit_id
parameters.description: Deposit ID of the trade in question.

post.description: Withdraw item directly if the auction has expired without being won.

parameters.name: deposit_id
parameters.description: Deposit ID of the trade in question.

post.description: Disputes a trade in case the seller did not send you the item, but marked the trade as 'sent'. Please do your best to keep false disputes at a minimum, otherwise we might impose restrictions.

parameters.name: tradeoffer_id
parameters.description: The trade offer ID of the trade in question, collected from the withdrawal endpoint response.

post.description: Mark an item as received after accepting the trade on Steam. This endpoint can also be used to complete a dispute after it has been opened.

parameters.name: tradeoffer_id
parameters.description: The trade offer ID of the trade in question, collected from the withdrawal endpoint response.

get.description: Returns an array of all auctions currently being bid on by this account.
Fetch your inventory from steam and caches it to the database for 1 hour.

invalid.description: Filters invalid items, defaults to no filtering.

data.invalid: This item is currently in an active deposit.

post.description: Used to update your trade URL or the marketplace privacy protection level.

parameters.name: depositId
parameters.description: Can be either a deposit ID, a trade ID or a bid ID.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Can be either of these: bid/deposit/withdrawal

get.description: Returns an array of all items currently being deposited or withdrawn by this account. This does not include bids placed on active items until the auction ends.

post.description: Used to tip other accounts using their Steam/Empire ID. This requires 2FA codes alongside your API key in order to work.

amount.description: The amount you want to tip in coin-cents (1 coin = 100 coincents)

steam_id.description: The Steam ID of the user you want to tip. This field is mutually exclusive with user_id, so it's optional.

user_id.description: The ID of the user you want to tip. This field is mutually exclusive with steam_id, so it's optional.
